## Why

Describe the problem and the resulting user experience.

## Changes

Explain the relevant audio, recording, scene, or UI changes.

## Verification

Describe the checks performed and any remaining hardware limitations. For recording changes, mention track alignment, mute/pause behavior, and recovery where relevant. Do not attach private recordings.

## Compatibility and contribution notes

For packs/media, include tested app versions, import steps and asset sources/licenses.
For module or project-format changes, describe cleanup, compatibility and migrations.
For UI changes, include screenshots and the smallest window tested. Docs-only changes
can report link/example checks instead of desktop tests. No private recordings are required.
